CustomField.description: This field will indicate a range in which the customer's AGS is in.
CustomField.formula: IF(AnnualRevenue < 100000, "R1: 0-99k", IF(AnnualRevenue < 250000, "R2: 100-249k", IF(AnnualRevenue < 500000, "R3: 250-499k", IF(AnnualRevenue < 1000000, "R4: 500-999k", IF(AnnualRevenue < 2500000, "R5: 1,000-2,499k", IF(AnnualRevenue >= 2500000, "R6: 2.5M+","Not Captured"))))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field will indicate a range in which the customer's AGS is in.
CustomField.label: AGS - Range
